models.description: gpt-5-mini on Microsoft Foundry, OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses APIs. Served from Sweden Central and fails over to France Central on throttling or errors. Requests with the header x-workload: batch go to France Central, keeping the primary's capacity for interactive traffic.
Mistral Large 3 on Microsoft Foundry, a second model family. OpenAI Chat Completions API.

models.optional: Deployed only when CLAUDE_ORGANIZATION_NAME is set: Claude deployments need your organization's attestation.
models.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 on Microsoft Foundry, Anthropic Messages API.

tools.description: Orders, stock, shipping quotes, and the returns specialist agent behind one endpoint: three backends federated by the gateway.
Delivery quotes by country and service. A private REST API, published as tools from its OpenAPI description.

tools.optional: Deployed only when the Microsoft Entra apps for on-behalf-of exist (scripts/deploy.sh creates them when it can).
tools.description: The signed-in user's own orders. The gateway calls the backend on behalf of the user, so it only ever returns that user's data.

orders.description: Private MCP server: orders and stock levels. Read-only, synthetic data.

shipping.description: Private REST API: delivery quotes, published from its OpenAPI description.

returns.description: The returns specialist: an agent behind an MCP tool. It only recommends a refund, replacement, repair, or decline.

my-orders.description: Private MCP server that accepts only user tokens that the gateway exchanged on-behalf-of.
